hook_summary: claims this is the free version of the top-charting paid competitor
why_it_worked: Comparison frame does the persuasion — viewer is already sold on the category by an incumbent, so the hook only has to establish parity + zero cost. Face + phone in hand within frame 0. Reveal by 0:03.
pacing_notes: hard cut at 1.4s, app UI on-screen by 2.9s, screen-record overlay for the middle 8s, back to face for CTA
cta: 'it's literally free, search caltrim' — soft rec, no download language

performance.value: 41+ days on Meta as of scrape

hook_summary: opens with 'the reason your rent went up isn't what they told you' over a b-roll of an empty apartment building
why_it_worked: Text-only cold open reads as leak/expose, not opinion. B-roll matches the emotion (empty building = 'something is off') without being literal. Voice starts at 0:00 with no music intro. Sources cited on-screen at the 0:12 mark buys credibility for the whole video.
pacing_notes: b-roll changes every 1.6s in first 15s then slows to 3s cuts as argument builds, chyron sources at 0:12 and 0:24
cta: 'part 2 in the pinned comment' — forces follow, not link

hook_summary: 'I stopped taking clients under $50k. Here's what happened.' Delivered walking through an actual office, not staged.
why_it_worked: Confident enough to alienate — filters non-buyers hard, which is the point for B2B. Specific number ($50k not '5-figures'), real setting (walking through workspace, not sitting at a desk), receipt in the promise ('here's what happened' — implies concrete outcome coming). Ends with 'was it worth it? — dm me the word revenue and I'll send you the P&L breakdown' which turns lead capture into a native ask.
pacing_notes: walking shot with natural head movement, cuts every 4s (slower than UGC), single b-roll cutaway to a spreadsheet at 0:22
cta: 'dm me the word revenue' — trades pitch for gated content, high-intent capture

performance.value: organic post, 340k views + 800+ DMs in first week per creator
